# Thesis Guidelines {.unnumbered}

Thesis guidelines are freely available on Canvas. For simplicity, you can find the link to the files below.

To open the correct file, please click on the name of your major:

[**Economic Psychology**](https://tilburguniversity.instructure.com/courses/22288/files/4572383?module_item_id=1069576)

[**Social Psychology**](https://tilburguniversity.instructure.com/courses/22943/files/4572385?module_item_id=1069580)

[**Work and Organisational Psychology**](https://tilburguniversity.instructure.com/courses/23438/files/4572387?module_item_id=1069583)

On Canvas you can also find the grading rubric, under the Thesis Assessment module. It is ***highly recommended*** that you take a look at this while writing different sections of your thesis, since you are graded based on this.
